what: the Docker real-machine lane on a real ubuntu:24.04, both modes
why_allow_rootful: this machine's Docker is ROOTFUL and the lane refuses it by default (`--require-docker` exits 3 with `this machine's Docker is ROOTFUL, not rootless`). `--allow-rootful-docker` is the lane's own documented opt-in, not a bypass invented here.

why_no_api_key.the_request: the user asked for the Docker lane with the API key imported from ~/.bashrc
why_no_api_key.measured_answer: THE LANE DOES NOT TAKE ONE, and staging a key would work against it. The run reported `boot.llmTurn=null — not attempted: a live LLM turn needs provider credentials and this container stages none (AGENTS.md §10)`, and the lane ASSERTS `isolation.noCredentials` on the premise that nothing was staged in the first place. Its session is created through `POST /api/session/create` with `agentPreset=mpd` — a MOUNT proof, not a model call.
why_no_api_key.so: the key was deliberately NOT passed. Passing it would have reddened isolation.noCredentials and converted a deliberate NULL into a claim the lane is not built to make.

oneclick_mode.the_three_nulls: build.bunInstall and build.dists (not applicable in one-click mode: the published package ships its built dists) plus boot.llmTurn (deliberate)
oneclick_mode.first_attempt_failed_on_a_NETWORK_FLAKE: `curl: (56) Failure when receiving data from the peer` fetching the bun binary from GitHub releases, at STEP 03-bun, 91s in. The SOURCE lane had passed the same step minutes earlier, so it was the network and not the step. The retry passed. Recorded rather than reported as a defect, and the failed run is kept as oneclick-attempt1-network-flake.log.

what_the_source_lane_proves: node 24 + bun + pnpm + @deepseek-ai/dsh install inside a bare ubuntu:24.04 container
the bundle installs with ONE command from a copy of the checkout (dsh plugin --profile web add .)
every packages/*/dist entry rebuilds from source with the canonical repo-root bun build
a MOUNTING boot in an isolated HOME/DSH_HOME applies the plugin tree and registers the mpd tools
the official TeamService is mounted in that process
the mpd session gate LISTENER is registered for a real mpd session (liveness, not composition)
the mpd preset really mounts: POST /api/session/create answers ok with agentPreset=mpd
not_claimed: any live LLM turn or model routing — no credentials are staged
